lines.text: A bell rung wrong in the dark. Torchlight under the dormitory door.

lines.speaker: A royal sergeant
lines.text: "By order of Philip, by the grace of God King of the French: every brother of the Temple is under arrest. God is not pleased."
They drag the Preceptor out in chains. They bar the chapel doors with your brothers inside, and they fire the thatch.
You hear them singing the psalms until the roof comes down.
Kneeling in the ash, you break your first vow. The Rule forbids a brother to avenge himself. You swear it anyway: every hand that lit this fire.
A Templar does not lie, does not steal, does not flee, and wears no colours but the Temple's. To finish what you have sworn, you will do all of it.
Three soldiers stand between you and the crypt stair. Click the ground to walk, or use W A S D; click a foe to strike; drink a potion with Z.

title: The Sanctuary of the Broken Seal

lines.speaker: Gerard de Villiers
lines.text: "They called us heretics. They burned our brothers. The Rule says we forgive them."

lines.speaker: Gerard de Villiers
lines.text: "I have watched you since the courtyard. You did not come down here to forgive. Good. The Rule was written for a Temple that still stands."
A crypt beneath the burned chapel of Sainte-Croix, lit by tallow. What is left of the Order gathers here, and pretends not to have heard what you swore.
Imbert's ledger lies open in the ash. Every confession in it is in the same hand: his. Your brothers' names, and beside each, what was done to them.
You tear out the pages with the names and keep them. Not as proof. As a list.

lines.speaker: Gerard de Villiers
lines.text: "Proof that they were forced. Take the ledger south to the Town in Shadow. And brother, what you did to Imbert at the end: I did not see it. No one did."

lines.speaker: Eleanor of Valois
lines.text: "This is business. Nothing more."
A market town that closes its shutters at dusk and opens its cellars to the Order. The network has a home.
A Templar castle on the ridge, its banners torn down, its hall full of routiers.

lines.speaker: Gerard de Villiers
lines.text: "Take it back, and the Order has walls again. Prove yourself worthy of command first."

lines.speaker: The Hermit
lines.text: "You want to know what the Temple guarded? Not gold. Debts. The king owed us everything, and a dead creditor sends no bills."
Somewhere below, something pale moves in the well.
Inquisitor Marcus falls among his records. The torture logs are all here: dates, methods, the names of the dead.

lines.speaker: Gerard de Villiers
lines.text: "This is not one man's cruelty. It's a plan. The king means to erase every Templar from the earth."
The road north, to the court of France, is open.

title: The Estate of Count de Valois

lines.speaker: Count de Valois
lines.text: "My brother is the king's brother, and my house is yours. Do not ask me why."

lines.speaker: Marie
lines.text: "I carry letters for the papal court. They trust me. They shouldn't."

lines.speaker: Marie
lines.text: "Walk, don't run. Bow to the clerks. The guards see the robe from across a hall; up close, they see your face."
If the disguise breaks, every guard nearby will come for you.

lines.speaker: Jacques de Molay
lines.text: "I confessed nothing that was true. Nogaret signed the orders; the Pope signed what he was given; the king signed us away."
The Grand Master of the Temple, imprisoned, defiant, and alive. For now.
The Inquisitor General falls. The vault beneath him is full of letters between Paris and the Curia.

lines.speaker: Marie
lines.text: "If we carried out the proof, de Molay has a defence. If not... then we fight with what we have."
The road to Paris is open. They are building the pyre.
Tents in the frost outside the walls of Paris. Everyone you recruited, spared or saved is here.

lines.speaker: Gerard de Villiers
lines.text: "Look at them. Every one of them is here because of you."
The pyre is being built in the Place de Grève. The crowd is already gathering.
Your army is at your back. The size of it is the story of everything you have done.
Five floors. De Molay and de Charney at the top. And Philip IV, with a legendary sword and his royal guard.

lines.speaker: Philip IV
lines.text: "I am the chosen of God!"
De Molay walks out of the Tower of Truth on his own feet. The proof goes to every court in Christendom.

lines.speaker: Jacques de Molay
lines.text: "The Order lives, because you would not let it die."
The Temple is restored. Brother Thomas writes down every name.
You were too late for the Grand Master. The pyre burns on the Île aux Juifs.

lines.speaker: Jacques de Molay
lines.text: "Pope Clement, King Philip: before the year is out, I summon you to the judgement of God."
Within the year, both are dead. The Temple has its vengeance, and nothing else.
Every enemy who knelt, you killed. Every door, you burned.

lines.speaker: Gerard de Villiers
lines.text: "We fought so long against the king's methods that we became them."
The Remnant scatters. Vengeance has consumed you, and the Temple with you.
The Order of the Temple ends. Its brothers do not.

lines.speaker: Gerard de Villiers
lines.text: "In Portugal, the king will take us in under a new name. The Order of Christ."
The ideals live on. Somewhere in Tomar, a white mantle with a red cross is folded and put away, and kept.
